inj.note: Jefferson led the Vikings in receptions with the aid of a team-high target total, and the highlight of the perennial Pro Bowler's afternoon was his touchdown grab. Jefferson stuck his hand up and tapped Kyler Murray's (hamstring) pass to himself while in tight coverage in the left corner of the end zone early in the second quarter, ultimately securing a memorable one-yard score. Jefferson has topped 50 receiving yards just three times and is still in search of his first 100-yard game of the season, but he's found the end zone in two of the last three games heading into a Week 9 home showdown against the Bills on Monday night, Nov. 9.

news.h: Vikings acknowledge Justin Jefferson's frustration: Must get him the ball
news.d: Justin Jefferson declined to speak with reporters after Sunday's loss, and coach Kevin O'Connell and QB Kyler Murray acknowledged the receiver's disposition.

news.h: Justin Jefferson on down year amid Vikes' 6-0 start: 'What we're doing is working'
news.d: Justin Jefferson, whose 23 catches are a career low through the first seven weeks of a season, said ultimately what the 6-0 Vikings are doing now "is working."
